item.title: Pedestrian killed in crash on Raymond Road in Jackson
item.description: JACKSON, Miss. (WJTV) - Jackson police are investigating after a pedestrian was killed during a crash. The incident occurred on Raymond Road near Wilson Boulevard on March 2, 2026. Police have not identified the pedestrian.
